title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to hide the Sales Order Agent and Payables Agent icons in the upper right corner
summary: The Sales Order Agent and Payables Agent icons appear by default in Business Central's upper right corner. You can hide them by deactivating individual capabilities on the Copilot & agent capabilities page, then signing out and back in.
key_points: Sales Order Agent automates sales order capturing in Business Central
Payables Agent processes vendor invoices end-to-end to reduce accounting bottlenecks
Both agent icons display on the role center and embedded pages by default
Deactivate agents through the Copilot & agent capabilities page
Sign out and back in to make the icon visibility changes take effect

quotes.text: Sales Order Agent helps Business Central users automate capturing sales orders.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the primary function of the Sales Order Agent feature

quotes.text: The Payables Agent solves a decade-old challenge: end-to-end processing of vendor invoices.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the strategic value of the Payables Agent in addressing a long-standing business problem

quotes.text: Like most system features, you can't turn Copilot on or off. But you can deactivate individual capabilities.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies how agent features are controlled and customized in Business Central
